summary: T-0658 [security/системный, столп 4]: fail-closed `AND deactivated_at IS NULL` on EVERY live subject->authority resolver so a deactivated (fired) employee whose already-issued KC access token is still within its TTL (KC enabled:false blocks only NEW token issuance) loses ALL authorization inside Choros — plus a last-owner guard preventing the fix from bricking a tenant. FIVE authority paths closed across three rounds: (A) grant path getGrantsForSubject step 1 (grants-dao.ts) — every ordinary PDP consumer; (B) owner/admin parallel resolver org.ts (isGenesisOwnerForTenant + loadAdminContext x2 subqueries) which SHORT-CIRCUITS the grant PDP (round 2, adversarial REAL_HOLE); (C) report-page-render.ts non-owner delegated-reader branch (round 2); (D) rights-intents.ts self-absence — the ONLY authority-WRITING handler in that file not routed through loadAdminContext (round 3, adversarial REAL_HOLE): it resolved the actor by a bespoke inline slug->employee lookup + gated role-holding by a direct role_assignment read, neither checking deactivation, so a deactivated actor with a live token could declare self-absence and on the Tier-2 branch MINT a delegated grant into choros."grant" for a live accomplice (resolver A cannot catch this — the exploited subject is the accomplice, not deactivated; the deactivated party is the WRITER). Round 3 also fixes a SELF-LOCKOUT introduced by the round-2 org.ts gate: deactivating the LAST active tenant-owner made them isGenesisOwner=false with no one left to reactivate them (reactivation authz is loadAdminContext) — a bricked tenant. FIX-2 adds a LAST-OWNER GUARD to PATCH /api/users (active:false path): a pre-check counting OTHER active tenant-owners; if the target is the last, 409 LAST_OWNER before any KC/DB mutation. The systematic anti-recurrence mechanism (an identity-layer gate OR a static fitness gate catching any new slug->employee authority resolver missing the predicate) is carried to a SEPARATE task T-0662 (architect) — this task closes the five concrete holes + fixes the triage honestly, NOT a general refactor. Human vs agent unchanged: deactivated_at is structurally never set for kind='agent' (only writer PATCH /api/users is human-only), so every gate is a no-op for legitimate agents.

Fix restored, byte-identical to intended, both green.

With a SECOND owner seeded, deactivating one owner -> 200; then deactivating the remaining LAST owner (called as that owner, still active) -> 409 LAST_OWNER. MUTATION-VERIFIED: reverting user-mgmt.ts guard makes deactivating the sole owner return 200 (tenant bricked) — both FIX-2 tests go red; guard restored, both green.

friction_events: ROUND 3: the self-absence FIX-1 test first used the seeded ROLE_BUDGET and hit 422 NO_DELEGABLE_GRANT under mutation — that role's grants aren't inheritable-delegable for the self-absence mint path, so the 'no grant minted' assertion wasn't load-bearing (the mint couldn't fire regardless). Rewrote the test to seed a DEDICATED role with an explicitly delegable+inheritable grant + an active-actor positive control that proves the mint path is live (200 + ttl_grant_id). Now the mutation genuinely flips 404->200-with-real-mint. Also corrected the expected success status to 200 (the self-absence route returns 200, not 201, on a successful mint).

findings_out_of_scope: SYSTEMATIZATION -> T-0662 (per coordinator): the fact that five separate authority paths each needed the same predicate is a symptom of no unified identity/deactivation layer. Designing an anti-recurrence mechanism (identity-layer gate OR a static fitness gate that fails any new slug->employee authority resolver missing `deactivated_at IS NULL`) is carried to T-0662 (architect). T-0658 is the point fix, not the general mechanism.

pdp-explain.ts (src/http/pdp-explain.ts:119) — DIAGNOSTIC explain endpoint loads the subject's grants via its own local grant-source WITHOUT the gate. NOT a security hole: its own authz is loadAdminContext (gated round 2) + self-query. A self-query explain by a deactivated actor could DISPLAY grants the real PDP no longer honors — an explain-FIDELITY divergence, not authorization. Aligning explain fidelity is a follow-up (ADR §9); not fixed here because it authorizes nothing.
